name: RateLimitOp

test_list.description: Uses the injected DualLimiter and returns the original payload together with a non-cloneable Permit that remains available through downstream model work.
Returns the real limiter denial when priority shedding rejects the request; it never substitutes an unmetered success.
Propagates ExceedsBurst without returning an admission.
Admission wait ends on caller cancellation or the configured finite timeout; cancellation drops the wait future and no Permit escapes.
Downstream marks dispatch before transport handoff and reconciles final usage; dropping a possibly-dispatched reservation never refunds rate capacity.
RateLimitInput and RateLimited are single-owner values so the generic RetryOp cannot clone an admission across uncertain upstream work.
Rejects a zero admission deadline during operator construction instead of creating an unbounded or immediate-failure configuration.

inputs.name: RateLimitInput<T>
inputs.description: Owned payload, trusted prompt/output token reservation estimate, caller-selected priority, and cancellation token.

output_description: The owned payload plus an actual non-cloneable DualLimiter Permit. Downstream keeps this value through model work, calls mark_dispatched immediately before transport handoff, then consumes it to reconcile final provider usage.
